issue.title: Retire agent_sudo_requests
issue.description: Gate the typed sudo request workflow while the runner, ACE modal, skill guard, and SSH relay phases land.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Remove after the sudo runner, ACE review modal, provider guard, and SSH relay support have landed and the terminal workflow has soaked without rollback.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: SASE refuses new sudo requests and the sudo CLI with a concise opt-in hint while leaving already persisted gate data inspectable through generic gate surfaces.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: SASE exposes the typed sudo notification gate and terminal sudo request/answer/list/show workflow.

payload.entry: Retired agent_sudo_requests per epic sase-1jc user authorization (clean slate, all-enabled behavior). Removed src/sase/sudo/feature.py and all require_sudo_requests_enabled gates in sudo/cli.py and notification_gates/kind_validation/sudo.py; typed payload validation, reviewed approval, runner policy, single-use authority, cancellation, SSH relay, and persisted gate inspection preserved. Sudo acceptance/gate-answer/notification suites reworked to unconditional workflow and passing.
